children: raised its outlook for the third quarter of 2026 and its long-term financial algorithm to reflect “continued strong growth across all three segments.”

The parent company of Wilson, Salomon, and Arc’teryx now expects revenue to increase by 20% to 22% in Q3 versus an earlier range of 18% to 20% and adjusted operating margin to be slightly above the high end of the previous guidance range of 13.5% to 14%.
The company’s profit outlook remains unchanged at $0.31 to $0.33 per share.

Additionally, the company updated its long-term financial algorithm and sees an annual revenue compounded annual growth rate (CAGR) of low-double digits to mid-teens for the consolidated business and adjusted operating margin expansion of 30-70+ basis points.
For its technical apparel and outdoor performance segments, annual revenue CAGR is expected to be in the mid-teens, while adjusted operating margin is expected to expand by 20-60+ basis points.
In the ball and racquet segment, annual revenue CAGR is expected to be in the mid-to-high single digits with adjusted operating margin expansion of 20-60+ basis points.
The updated guidance was issued ahead of Thursday's Investor Day conference.

title: Amer Sports raises Q3 guidance, long-term financial algorithms
